title: Require Domain Operation Strategy Source Topology
forbids: domain operation strategy authorities outside a closed aggregate-and-leaf topology
why: Each operation's strategies directory is the strategy aggregate, and each semantic strategy is a complete leaf with its own contract and implementation entrypoint. The hierarchy preserves selectable behavior identity, prevents generic default identities and helper cabinets, and leaves strategy key binding, default inference, and implementation completeness to TypeScript and the operation SDK.
remediate: Keep strategies/{contract.ts,index.ts}; move every strategy into a semantically named kebab-case strategies/<strategy-id>/{contract.ts,index.ts} leaf; remove flat strategy modules and any default strategy directory.
message: Domain operation strategies must use the positive aggregate-and-leaf strategy topology.
